title: Feedback
description: The resulting feedback of an ACH transaction

externalId.description: The merchant reference of the payment.

status.description:
The final status of the payment operation:
* `2`: Authorized
* `3`: Processed
* `4`: Completed
* `5`: Failed
* `6`: Expired
* `7`: Canceled
* `9`: Disputed
* `10`: Reversed
* `13`: Voided

subStatus.description:
The ACH return code. Example:
* `R01`: Insufficient Fund
* `R04`: Invalid Account Number
* `R16`: Account Frozen

description.description: Unrestricted field to inform any description about the payment.

submissionDate.description: The Unix Timestamp (epoch) in ms of when the payment was sent to ACH.

returnDate.description: The Unix Timestamp (epoch) in ms of when ACH provided a return.

amount.description: The amount of the payment. (10 characters with support for 2 decimal places)

currency.description: 3-letter ISO Currency Code. Currently only USD is supported.

FeedbackCurrency.description: 3-letter ISO Currency Code. Currently only USD is supported.
